onboarding_description: Choose the language you're most comfortable with. We'll use it to explain Kannada phrases and guide your practice.
hero_p: Practical Kannada for moments that matter — from asking if a bus goes to your stop, to ordering filter coffee, bargaining at local markets, or asking for help at a clinic.
hero_card_eyebrow: A LITTLE KANNADA GOES A LONG WAY
hero_art_caption: Learn it. Say it. Use it.
hero_art_aria_label: Illustration of a Kannada conversation card
speech_no_kannada_voice: No Kannada voice is available on this device.
stats_tagline: Confidence grows with every real conversation.
explore_p: Select a situation or search by Kannada text, English meaning, or transliteration.
explore_search_placeholder: Search a phrase, meaning, or situation…
explore_empty: No phrases match your search. Try searching by English meaning, or choose another category above.
explore_search_error: We could not load phrases right now. Please try again.
practice_h2: Real life, one phrase at a time.
practice_p: Understand the situational prompt and choose the most effective, polite response.
practice_aside_p: Every response includes clear explanations of why it works or which context it actually belongs to. Missed phrases are automatically added to your Adaptive Revision queue.
feedback_revision_hint: This phrase has been added to your Adaptive Revision queue for review.
revision_p: Phrases you struggled with during conversation practice are prioritized here until you feel confident.
revision_empty: 🎉 Fantastic! You have no tricky phrases pending revision. Take on a practice scenario round to test your recall!
saved_p: Phrases you save are persistently stored in your database for quick offline recall.
saved_empty: You haven't saved any phrases yet. Click the heart (♥) on any phrase card in the Explore view to keep it here.
ai_p: Practice Kannada exchanges for everyday situations. Powered by your configured AI provider or our deterministic local engine.
ai_context_directions: Asking for Directions on the Street
ai_input_placeholder: Type in your language, English, or transliteration (e.g. 'How do I order dosa?')...
ai_fallback_notice: Offline fallback used — this is not a Gemini-generated answer.
